<!--
Local preview of the site's Presentations page.
Content lives in ../_data/presentations.yml — edit that file only, then Knit.
This file lives in preview/ on purpose: its knit output must never land at the repo root,
where it would overwrite the real presentations.html.
Requires: install.packages(c("yaml","htmltools"))
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(yaml)
```

```{r assets}
cat('<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">',
    '<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">',
    '<style>', paste(readLines("../assets/css/listing.css", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), '</style>',
    sep = "\n")
```

```{r page}
d <- yaml::read_yaml("../_data/presentations.yml")

kinds  <- c("Invited talk", "Contributed talk", "Workshop", "Panel", "Poster")
labels <- c("Invited talks", "Contributed talks", "Workshops & tutorials",
            "Panels & roundtables", "Posters")
months <- c("January","February","March","April","May","June",
            "July","August","September","October","November","December")

esc  <- function(x) gsub("<", "&lt;", gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE)
bold <- function(x) gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "<b>\\1</b>", esc(x))

year  <- vapply(d, function(e) e$year,  numeric(1))
month <- vapply(d, function(e) e$month, numeric(1))
kind  <- vapply(d, function(e) e$kind,  character(1))
d     <- d[order(-year, -month)]
kind  <- kind[order(-year, -month)]

n <- function(k) sum(kind == k)

cat('<div class="pres">',
    '<header class="lst-head"><div class="lst-head-row"><h1>Presentations</h1>',
    sprintf('<div class="lst-span">%d&ndash;%d</div></div>', min(year), max(year)),
    '<p class="lst-intro">Invited and contributed talks, panels, teaching workshops,',
    'and posters. Filter by format or search a title, collaborator, or venue.</p></header>',
    '<div class="lst-stats">',
    sprintf('<div class="lst-stat"><b>%d</b><span>Presentations</span></div>', length(d)),
    sprintf('<div class="lst-stat"><b>%d</b><span>Invited talks</span></div>', n("Invited talk")),
    sprintf('<div class="lst-stat"><b>%d</b><span>Posters</span></div>', n("Poster")),
    sprintf('<div class="lst-stat"><b>%d</b><span>Workshops &amp; panels</span></div>',
            n("Workshop") + n("Panel")),
    '</div>', sep = "\n")

cat('<div class="lst-bar"><div class="lst-chips">',
    sprintf('<button type="button" class="lst-chip" data-group="all" aria-pressed="true">All <i>%d</i></button>', length(d)),
    paste(sprintf('<button type="button" class="lst-chip" data-group="%s" aria-pressed="false">%s <i>%d</i></button>',
                  kinds, labels, vapply(kinds, n, numeric(1))), collapse = ""),
    '</div><input type="search" class="lst-search" placeholder="Search title, author, venue"></div>',
    '<p class="lst-empty">Nothing matches that filter.</p>', sep = "\n")

for (i in seq_along(kinds)) {
  items <- d[kind == kinds[i]]
  if (!length(items)) next
  cat(sprintf('<section class="lst-section"><div class="lst-group"><h2>%s</h2><span>%d</span></div>',
              labels[i], length(items)))
  for (e in items) {
    links <- if (!is.null(e$links))
      sprintf('<div class="lst-links">%s</div>',
              paste(vapply(e$links, function(l)
                sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', l$url, esc(l$label)),
                character(1)), collapse = "")) else ""
    cat(sprintf(paste0('<article class="lst-item" data-groups="%s"><div><div class="lst-year">%d</div>%s</div>',
                       '<div><div class="lst-tags"><span class="lst-kind%s">%s</span></div>',
                       '<h3>%s</h3><p class="lst-authors">%s</p><p class="lst-venue">%s</p>%s</div></article>'),
                e$kind, e$year,
                if (e$month > 0) sprintf('<div class="lst-month">%s</div>', months[e$month]) else "",
                if (e$kind == "Invited talk") " is-accent" else "",
                esc(e$kind), esc(e$title), bold(e$authors), esc(e$venue), links))
  }
  cat('</section>')
}
cat('</div>')

cat('<script>', paste(readLines("../assets/js/listing.js", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), '</script>', sep = "\n")
```
